correction.proposed_synopsis: Fourteen weeks after the Trump Taj Mahal opened in Atlantic City, The Washington Post reported that unpaid bills were approaching $90 million. An attorney for a contractor said $72.8 million was owed to construction firms, and about 70 contractors were preparing to meet over whether to continue negotiations or sue. The record supports a substantial unpaid-contractor dispute at the Taj Mahal, but not the stored Trump Plaza/1992 framing or a blanket finding of fraud across Trump properties.
